title: Is Trump's new 'Truth API' insider trading? | About That
text:
Is Trump's new 'Truth API' insider trading? | About That

When U.S. President Donald Trump posts on Truth Social, the stock market reacts. But what if investors could pay for early access? Andrew Chang explains what Trump Media is selling with Truth API — a subscription service that gives users a head start on the president's posts — and examines whether it fits the definition of insider trading.
